department: Department of Earth & Planetary Sciences (Doerr School of Sustainability)

deadline.value: Apply by 11:59pm PST, December 4, 2026 for Autumn 2027. Fee-waiver requests are due November 23, 2026.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for both the Master’s and PhD programs for an Autumn 2027 start is December 4, 2026, 11:59 pm PST.

also.quote: All fee waiver requests must be submitted by November 23, 2026, 11:59 PM (PST).

gre_subject.quote: No, the GRE is not required and will not be considered for admission.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required and will not be considered.
gre_general.quote: No, the GRE is not required and will not be considered for admission.

supervisor.value: The FAQ does not require a pre-arranged advisor; you apply to one department.

funding.value: Admitted students get substantial aid (tuition plus quarterly salary) from fellowships and assistantships and are considered for funding automatically; international students are eligible.
funding.quote: Graduate students admitted to EPS receive substantial financial aid (including tuition) from combinations of departmental fellowships, teaching or research assistantships, and other sources (including external fellowships). | Admitted students are automatically considered for funding.

also.quote: EPS department welcomes all students, regardless of their nationality or migratory status, to apply and be considered for funding

entry_route.value: Bachelor's holders can apply directly to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: No. Applicants who have a bachelor’s degree may apply directly to our doctoral program.

notes: Geophysics is a separate Doerr School department with its own PhD.
